notes.title: 💭 ADTCE is Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Super excited to finally say… A Dream That Changes Everything (ADTCE) is now available on Steam! 🎉[/p][p]It’s been a long journey, and we’re proud to share this intimate, emotional, and a little bit spicy story with you all. If you’re into H visual novels with a real story (and more than just the scenes 👀), this one’s definitely worth a look.[/p][p]🖤 What’s ADTCE About?[/p][p]“I grew up in a quiet town, spending my days with my best friend, Michelle…”[/p][p]You play as a young woman trying to find her way after life flips upside down. When her father passes away and things get rough at home, she moves to a new city — and into the apartment of her best friend, Michelle.[/p][p]She’s always been sweet. Supportive.[/p][p]But something feels… different now.[/p][p]Is it comfort, curiosity, or something more?[/p][p]Want to know what happens next?[/p][p]You know what to do. 😉[/p][p]🔥 Key Features:[/p][p]🌙 Mature, emotionally-driven narrative[/p][p]💋 Multiple love interests (not just one path to love… or lust)[/p][p]🔥 Fully illustrated H-scenes — sensual, not just spicy[/p][p]If you’re into heartfelt H-stories with actual depth — give ADTCE a try.[/p][p]Let us know what you think, leave a review, and maybe… share your favourite scene (we won’t judge 👀)[/p][p]– Pjoy Games[/p][p]
[/p]
